name: HTTP Client Log
description: Records outbound Guzzle HTTP client requests and responses as content entities with a viewer, detail pages, and filter settings.
project_description: Logs the outbound HTTP requests and responses Drupal makes through \Drupal::httpClient() (the core Guzzle client). It decorates core's http_client_factory service and pushes a Guzzle log middleware (covergenius/guzzle_logger) onto the handler stack; every outbound request that passes the configured filters is stored as an http_client_log content entity capturing the request method, URL, headers and payload plus the response status, reason phrase, headers and body. An admin View at /admin/reports/http-client-logs lists the entries, each has a detail page, a settings form controls which requests are recorded (global toggle, URL allow/deny wildcard patterns, time-of-day and day-of-week windows, request-method filter, response-status filter, and response Content-Type filter), and hook_cron prunes the table to a retention limit. Intended for debugging third-party API integrations; shipped in the Development package.
